interactions.teaches: Credibility is not the same as plausibility. Four implausible histories occurred, one plausible story was invented.
interactions.studentAction: Mark all five cases Real/Fake, then lock. Reveal remains hidden until five selections.
interactions.feedback: Per-card historical/invented verdicts and aggregate score appear only once locked.
interactions.staticFallback: The page includes all five cases and an explanation of the fake in the next section.
interactions.identityFit: Five Wonderland playing cards. Reveal erupts in vivid yellow.

interactions.teaches: Different errors in judgment explain why different deceptions succeeded.
interactions.feedback: Per-case success marker plus written explanation, with option to show reasons.
interactions.staticFallback: Each match and explanation is reproduced in prose.
interactions.identityFit: Four cards dealt beside an evidence table.

interactions.teaches: A behavior may illustrate a construct without proving a clinical diagnosis.
interactions.studentAction: Choose the strongest construct for three fictional scenarios.
interactions.feedback: Immediate explanatory feedback that does not diagnose.
interactions.staticFallback: Character chapters define the traits in text.
interactions.identityFit: Wonderland figures act as story guides, not clinical patients.

interactions.teaches: Transfer a habit of critical judgment to a new claim.
interactions.studentAction: Write three answers in labeled textareas.
interactions.feedback: Shared desk-save.js provides account-based saved work, work controls and Turn In on the deployed site; this page does not maintain duplicate student data.
interactions.staticFallback: Paper equivalent: answer three questions in writing, then discuss.
interactions.identityFit: A final set of three paper verdict panels closes the story.
